checkedAlternates.risk: Vinegar starts from fermented apple cider.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Vinegar’s defining final step is Acetobacter oxidizing ethanol into acetic acid (group-1), not yeast alcohol production (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Sauerkraut is sour and acidic like vinegar.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Sauerkraut’s acidity comes from lactic acid bacteria (group-4), not acetic acid bacteria (group-1).
